_meta.note: Reward values are ILLUSTRATIVE. There are NO predefined actions — the VLM judges any action open-set and suggests points; the scoring block below turns that into a deterministic number (the model never sets the payout — CLAUDE.md #6).

scoring.note: points = clamp(suggested_points, min_points, max_points) x eco_relevance x quality_multiplier. eco_relevance (0-1) is the brain's judgment of HOW eco-friendly the action is, so weaker actions score proportionally less.
